crossRefs.note: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.
Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?

translations.web: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,
translations.bsb: For the redemption of his soul is costly, and never can payment suffice,
translations.kjv: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)
translations.asv: (For the redemption of their life is costly, And it faileth for ever;)
